features: Fixes Scoring Tests competitor generation in application code instead of relying on schema migration
Copies only competitor columns that actually exist in disposable test storage
Competitor photos including original_photo_url are fully optional and never block test generation
Manual and Automatic Test mode selection now opens the schema-safe test runner
Existing test scoring UI and shared BDC scoring engine remain unchanged
No official competitor, points, progression, publication or production scoring data is modified
No Staging or Production deployment performed
